latest_release.name: Mautic Community 7.2.2
latest_release.body:
## Announcing Mautic 7.2.2: Alsciaukat Edition

### Security Release
This release addresses several security vulnerabilities. We strongly advise updating your installation at your earliest convenience after performing a full backup and testing the upgrade in a staging environment.

### 🔒 Security Fixes
* **CVE-2026-115188: Remote Code Execution in Campaign Import**
  * **Attribution:** Reported by @m0xath, @iys8, @DavidCarliez, @Forrof, @sdrk3nD, @Hama1cco, @4n86rakam1, and @calbebop. Fixed by @patrykgruszka. Reviewed by @escopecz.
  * **Advisory:** [GHSA-mxjf-pghx-h299](https://github.com/mautic/mautic/security/advisories/GHSA-mxjf-pghx-h299)

* **CVE-2026-115189: Twig Sandbox Escape in Theme Templates**
  * **Attribution:** Reported by @amagesh1, @manus-use, @sec-reex, @prakhar0x01, @lostfany, @trungpv19, @SRTSubmersionAI, @CyberKareem, @m0xath, @Forrof, @cxcsec, @lucasdodgson, @FlowOverFail, @tal2k9dev-star, and @tlavi00. Analysis by @Den1al. Fixed by @amagesh1. Reviewed by @escopecz and @patrykgruszka.
  * **Advisory:** [GHSA-h7pm-79gc-8867](https://github.com/mautic/mautic/security/advisories/GHSA-h7pm-79gc-8867)

* **CVE-2026-115191: SQL Injection in Contact Lookup AJAX Endpoint**
  * **Attribution:** Reported by @cuongkt194, @tiencong-98, @bharatdevasani, @pavelkohout396, @blvck-ltr, @Haxset, @cy3erm, @Infinit3i, @AdamKorcz, and @manus-pi. Fixed by @cuongkt194. Reviewed by @escopecz and @patrykgruszka.
  * **Advisory:** [GHSA-fj8v-c9c3-7q26](https://github.com/mautic/mautic/security/advisories/GHSA-fj8v-c9c3-7q26)

* **CVE-2026-115192: SQL Injection in Dashboard Widget API**
  * **Attribution:** Reported by @pavelkohout396, @skeletonsec, @abdugafforov-bobur, and @AdamKorcz. Coordinated by @wsparks-vc. Fixed by @abdugafforov-bobur. Reviewed by @escopecz and @patrykgruszka.
  * **Advisory:** [GHSA-qpmx-7pq3-5q2v](https://github.com/mautic/mautic/security/advisories/GHSA-qpmx-7pq3-5q2v)

* **CVE-2026-115193: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in HTML-type Custom Contact Field on Contact Detail View**
  * **Attribution:** Reported by @EndlssNightmare, @im-rootkid, @m0xath, @EvidentObscurity, @tinyb0y, and @wewea00. Fixed by @m0xath. Reviewed by @escopecz and @patrykgruszka.
  * **Advisory:** [GHSA-3295-vq3p-93rw](https://github.com/mautic/mautic/security/advisories/GHSA-3295-vq3p-93rw)

* **CVE-2026-115194: Arbitrary File Read via Path Traversal in Asset API**
  * **Attribution:** Reported by @cristibtz, @louissanchez-vokecyber, @pavelkohout396, @toyakula, and @Forrof. Fixed by @cristibtz. Reviewed by @escopecz and @patrykgruszka.
  * **Advisory:** [GHSA-wfhm-289v-79vp](https://github.com/mautic/mautic/security/advisories/GHSA-wfhm-289v-79vp)

* **CVE-2026-115195: Broken Access Control in Stats API**
  * **Attribution:** Reported by @abdugafforov-bobur and @joostgrunwald. Coordinated by @wsparks-vc. Fixed by @abdugafforov-bobur. Reviewed by @escopecz and @patrykgruszka.
  * **Advisory:** [GHSA-7j28-9rg4-wg63](https://github.com/mautic/mautic/security/advisories/GHSA-7j28-9rg4-wg63)

* **CVE-2026-115196: Open Redirect in Form Submission**
  * **Attribution:** Reported by @geo-chen, @kodareef5, @ZeroXJacks, and @sun1024. Fixed by @escopecz. Reviewed by @patrykgruszka.
  * **Advisory:** [GHSA-5mm3-3g7p-9868](https://github.com/mautic/mautic/security/advisories/GHSA-5mm3-3g7p-9868)

## What's Changed
### 🐛 Bugs
#### :file_folder: Assets
* Downloaded assets now keep their original filename instead of an internal ID by @patrykgruszka in https://github.com/mautic/mautic/pull/17526
#### :technologist: Automated tests
* Remove test code that could never run after an expected exception by @dylanpulver in https://github.com/mautic/mautic/pull/17615
#### :rocket: Campaigns
* Campaign screens now consistently say "activate" and "reactivate" instead of "publish" and "republish" by @AlexanderZlobinM1 in https://github.com/mautic/mautic/pull/17678
#### :busts_in_silhouette: Contacts
* Frequency
